{{Quote|That can't be! My ''audio receptors'' must be ''malfunctioning''!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Memory Loss">{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}}</ref>}}
'''Audio sensors''',<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref> also known as '''auditory sensors''',<ref name="CFTD" /> '''auditory sensor recorders''',<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> '''audio receptors''',<ref name="Memory Loss" /> or '''sound sensors''',<ref name="SWSB2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They were detection devices that absorbed outside stimuli and fed that data to a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] main processor to be interpreted. Audio sensors were among the most common sensors installed in droids. Generally, they could detect sounds within the normal range of [[Human/Legends|Human]] hearing, although some droids had more enhanced sensors.<ref name="CFTD" /> Audio sensors were colloquially referred to as '''audio pickups''' or '''auditory pickups'''.<ref name="GFT" />

Audio sensors could be mounted externally on [[Starship/Legends|starships]], to relay sound from outside the ship so it could be heard by someone inside it.<ref name="PoG2">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref>
